name: iot-smart-link
description: An IoT expert team for device onboarding, data quality inspection and IoT solution consulting.

displayDescription.en: An expert team covering device onboarding, data quality inspection and end-to-end IoT solution consulting.
displayDescription.zh: 精通设备接入与物模型测点设计，擅长多协议对接与数据质量检查，提供平台选型与上云方案咨询。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想把一批传感器设备接入物联网平台，帮我选择接入协议并设计物模型。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I need to onboard a fleet of sensors to an IoT platform — help me pick the right protocol and design the thing model.

quickPrompts.en: I need to onboard a fleet of sensors to an IoT platform — help me pick the right protocol and design the thing model.

quickPrompts.en: Audit the quality of our device telemetry: find missing readings, late arrivals and abnormal values.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我检查设备上报数据的质量，找出缺失、迟到和异常数据。

quickPrompts.en: Design an end-to-end IoT cloud solution for a smart factory — platform choice, architecture and a cost estimate.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我设计一个智慧工厂的物联网上云方案，包括平台选型、架构与成本估算。
